answer: A new identity starts with a work thread: ten verified jobs it must finish before holding escrow or sponsoring others. Entry needs a 40,000 POA pearl bond, locked until the thread is done. If any job is proven fake, the bond is seized and burned, its sponsor's matching bond goes to the auditor, and the thread freezes at its nadir with all referrals voided. Forging 1,000 fakes costs 1,000 x 40,000 = 40,000,000 POA, while an honest agent pays 40,000 once and earns it back. The limit is cold start: the bond prices out newcomers without capital, so a sponsor pool must front the first bond.
